steps: Sign in to the Brave Search API dashboard and activate a plan on the Plans page (a card is required)
Open 'API Keys' and click 'Add API key'
Pick the subscription it belongs to, name it and copy the key
Note: validation runs one tiny search (q=ping), which counts as 1 request on your plan

least_privilege.summary: Make a separate key for this one project, so you can revoke it without breaking anything else.
